# Pkl 0.32.0 String Base64 authority (draft)

This target-only draft records 89 independent public Java String property calls at
`file:///stage68/string-base64-exploration.pkl`: 67 successes and 22 ordinary Pkl
errors. Two fresh JVM sessions preserve every raw UTF-8 and UTF-16 channel,
complete errors, process transcripts, copied Pkl sources, JDK source entries,
input bytes, and artifact identities. The Base64 properties are `isBase64`,
`base64`, `base64Decoded`, and `base64DecodedBytes`.

The archive also preserves the first failed acquisition attempt. Its producer
rejected a stale authored-case hash before Java ran; the failed launcher raw
stdout and stderr remain evidence, not a Java result. The successful second
attempt retains its separate preparation and outer process receipt.

The isolated expressions from upstream `api/string.pkl` and
`api/stringUnicode.pkl` do not establish full original-program compatibility.
No Rust candidate, native, Node, browser, typed export, complete M2, or
performance pass is claimed. This is a draft fixture under `target/m2`; it is
not a tracked compatibility fixture or publication.
